market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-volatile. Oil above $107 and 10Y yield near 5% create a stagflationary pressure. US CPI is the immediate catalyst—hot print accelerates bond selloff and equity de-rating. Bessent's failed jawboning signals policy incoherence. Expect continued Asia selloff, elevated VIX, and sector rotation into energy/defense. Apple foldable provides a narrow tech bright spot. Trade war with Canada adds noise. Net: risk-off bias for 1-3 months.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive with structural headwinds. AI capex cycle (Nvidia's 'tens of trillions' thesis) and data center buildout (CAT, NetApp) provide secular growth. However, oil supply risk from Middle East is structural, not cyclical. Trade fragmentation (US-Canada, US tariffs on copper) raises input costs. AI safety concerns (Anthropic warnings, OpenAI doomer on board) may trigger regulatory overhang. Healthcare (JNJ, UNH) and energy remain best risk-adjusted. 6-12 month: expect range-bound equities with energy and defense outperforming.
